parsed.explanation: Visitor-facing risks include the transport police’s birth-sex strip-search policy and a statutory single-sex spaces code that UN experts warn could exclude trans people. A regional court has also struck down guidance permitting some gender-identity-based prison placements. A reported hospital case raises serious concerns about care, although the claim remains unresolved. Gender-reassignment discrimination protection remains in law, but the dossier does not establish that it remedies these exposures in practice. The code’s application, entry treatment and regional differences remain uncertain; domestic recognition restrictions are not themselves visitor restrictions.
